meta.scope: Separate S015 AI4Pain development from same-protocol GUI holdout

records.title: Real-Time Pain Assessment from Electrodermal Activity Using Deep Learning

decisions.notes: Controlled TENS-evoked experimental pain in healthy participants; EDA reflects autonomic response and does not establish chronic-pain, ECAP, or SCS-outcome validity. Rechecked 2026-09-28: GUI group is unseen but uses the same laboratory protocol and sensors, so it is a participant holdout rather than external site/dataset validation. Results: 0.47 ms Table 7, 79.23% Table 9, 73.14% Table 10/Results 3.4. Article Methods 2.1 prose says 65 no-pain instances while Table 1 reports 715 no-pain observations; this internal discrepancy is not resolved.

searches.query: S015 cohort split GUI unseen same protocol Tables 7 9 10

evidence.sample_size: 65 AI4Pain participants in subject-wise five-fold evaluation; separate 15 previously unseen participants in same-protocol GUI evaluation (not one pooled evaluation cohort).
